title: Glossy
recognition: Look for bright, concentrated reflections of the light source.

confused_with.difference: Glossy: sharp bright reflections; semi-glossy: softer highlights; satin: broad gentle sheen. Lighting and viewing angle are confounders.
Metallic has a metal-like or angle-dependent coloured sheen; ordinary gloss is strong specular reflection without a metallic glaze.
